svg.title: Figure 2 · Every look the library can make
svg.desc: Every environment under every condition, with the scenes that use each look
svg.text: Figure 2 · Every look the library can make
Each environment under each condition, lit roughly as viewer.js lights it: sky from the condition's tint or the environment's sky, ground under ambient plus sun,
fog fading to the sky. 6 of 12 pairs are used, by the scenes named in them.
Used by a scene or variant
An approximation of the viewer's lighting for comparing looks, not a render; the stills are rendered from the pages themselves.

Generated by tools/figures/lookslib_readme.py from the look library, the scenes that use it and the viewer that reads it. Looks are picture only: a condition such as fog never changes a run (test_scenes3d.py).
